reviews.text: DJ is the best dog trainer ever! We took our puppy to puppy preschool and DJ was super informative and professional with Lilah. She accommodated Lilah’s small size and even helped out with keeping her safe from larger puppies. We will definitely be back week after week and Lilah will be a lifetime member of zoom room! Here is a pic of Lilah napping after her big day.
My dog has a blast at their classes and most importantly, the trainers are Certified Professional Dog Trainers (CPDT) who practice positive reinforcement training. That’s a must-have for us.

The Zoom Room has become our dog class home. My Bernedoodle puppy and I did a set of classes at a competing school that I really liked but I heard of the Zoom Room from another dog parent and decided to try it. Even though I was happy with the other school, Zoom Room is so much better!
First, they only do classes, no boarding or day care. That means no urine smell! A full class is 50 minutes and it’s so nice to breathe comfortably the whole time instead of feeling vaguely nauseous from a stench that can never fully be eradicated.
Second, there’s air conditioning. It’s not super cold ac but even when it’s hot outside, the training room is comfortable.
Last, and most importantly, the trainers/teachers are better. They just seem more experienced, have a lot more ideas (that work!) and I have learned a lot from them.

Just had our first training with Nora!!!
She is amazing, keeps everyone engaged and is amazing !the skills  taught are so practical to your daily needs

Love this place. The class has been a great way to help our puppy build confidence, learn how to interact appropriately with other dogs, and get comfortable in new environments. The trainers are knowledgeable, patient, and really take the time to explain things and answer questions. We’ve already noticed a difference in our puppy’s confidence and behavior. Highly recommend Zoom Room for anyone looking for a positive and supportive environment for their puppy!

Kiki is learning! I am also learning :)
I signed up for the monthly membership and my dog is really benefitting from just having such new experiences that reinforce good behaviors.

I had been doing most of the training myself but this is still excellent in helping me, our last month I couldn't make it to the puppy classes so I converted to private training sessions- I just wanted to see if my dog would like obstacles (even though we are working on basics still like manners) and she did!

Recommended if you can afford that would be the only way I would stop coming

We have brought several dogs here for training as puppies .  Matty, who teaches our Advanced Obedience Class is  bright, patient, clear in her explanations and totally committed to their success.   As a teacher myself, I really appreciate her talent in dealing with both the owners and their puppy-children .  I always feel that I’ve learned something important after her classes .
Thanks for the 5 stars, Sarah!  We love being a part of the Culver City community!
Thanks for the 5 stars, Craig!
Thanks for the 5 stars, Olivia!

Been coming to Zoom Room for the past 3 months and have seen a noticeable difference in my pups behavior! We've taken Puppy+ and Obedience, and both classes were super helpful in teaching me be the best human for my dog. DJ is my favorite, and Omar is great too!

We brought our puppy to Zoom Room every week for months when we brought him home and looking back, it was the best thing we did for him now that he is fully grown. The puppy socialization gave him confidence around other dogs (we even made new friends) and the training has stuck with him (including training us how to train). We’re really like the trainers and class formats, and the store inside is fantastic. We tell everyone to check out Zoom Room!
It was a great place when we first started going but the last couple of sessions after the revamp were different and stressful.

Dj, Omar and Matty are all amazing trainers! I worked with Matty for the first time today and was pleasantly surprised! My puppy has been in their puppy training class, puppy training + and now obedience. They also offer private training and agility classes.

Daisy really enjoys her Zoom Room visits.  We had both obedience and agility classes.  The instructors are positive and encouraging to both the pupils and the handler/owner.  BUT remember to do some of the training at home whenever possible.
I was able to bring another pup/pug a couple of times, too.  He really needs training.

I am very happy with the staff and Matty. You all are patient and supportive.
Thank you!
I had our first class and the teacher, Dj was great! Can’t wait to be back for the 2nd class!

This is an amazing facility that truly cares about pups and their families. When another dog training location closed, Culver City received us and treated us so nicely. All of the staff are so friendly and caring. I enjoy all of their classes and they are so supportive and patient.
Omar is patient and encouraging. He has a keen observation of both owner and dog. I try to make all my agility classes with Omar.

My husband & I have been taking our puppy Pizmo to Zoom Room for almost a year.

At first, we took her to the Woodland Hills location - and when this spot unexpectedly shut down, the friendly folks at the Culver City location kindly took us in & even let us redeem our remaining class credits we had purchased from Woodland Hills.
We were impressed by the Culver City staff immediately - they are all incredibly accommodating, knowledgeable, and genuinely attentive to our needs for Pizmo.

I’d like to particularly mention Nayamka (manager) and DJ (trainer), who have been absolutely wonderful.  They both exemplify quality customer service & being true dog experts.  I appreciate how much they also invest in coaching us humans to establish strong & healthy connections with our pups, which is essential to training.

Happy to share that as of today, Pizmo has finally graduated from her Obedience class!  There’s hope yet for our adorably rambunctious little one :)

Thank you, Nayamka & DJ, for making our Zoom Room experience such a positive one so far!
It was not just that the staff was knowledgable.  They paid special attention to my dog''s needs.

This is a great place to train your dogs, both obedience and agility. Shoutout to DJ! She's sooooo attentive during class to give tips and small corrections that make a big difference, and she has such positive energy which helps me hype up my dog too.
Very unprofessional front desk staff.

Wow great place the team is very attentive, profesional and knowledge about training.
Omar is the geatest master for any dog he was amazing with our pet.
I definitely recomend this place.
Thank you to all the team.geat experience.

We’ve been going to Zoom Room for a couple of months now, and I can already see a big difference in our dog’s focus, she’s become much more comfortable around other dogs and people, and she’s learning skills that are actually useful in everyday life.

Our orientation was with Nanyamka, who was lovely. She clearly explained how everything works and answered all of my questions. Since then, we’ve been taking classes with DJ and Deshawn, and both have been wonderful. They’re knowledgeable, encouraging, and make the classes fun. I would absolutely recommend taking classes with them.

I do wish there were a few more evening classes on the weekends, but so far I’ve been able to find open classes that fit my schedule.

Highly recommend!

We love going to Zoom Room. My dog is more attentive and responsive. She is also starting with agility classes, which I think she will love once she understands that is all about play. The staff is attentive  and nice.

Omar is great! Our pup adores him.  We just took our first private training session with him and learned a lot!   We have taken several group classes from him so he knew exactly what we needed work on and was prepared with several activities that proved helpful!  Highly recommend!

Benji loves going to the Zoom Room.  Omar is amazing!  He understands my dog and gives me great suggestions when working with him. Benji gets so excited when I tell him that we are going to Zoom Room to see Omar! Thanks
Benji loves the Zoom Room! Omar is amazing. He really understands my dog and makes learning fun. Thank you Omar!

Ashley made it easy for my dog Ollie to get back into training. Very good session.

Back at Zoom Room and this time had DJ for advanced obedience class. She is very good ! She explained what was needed to get Ollie prepared for his Canine Good Citizenship Certificate. Sundays are less crowded on Teale street since all the other businesses are closed for the day. Better parking. Ollie did well he got his focus master badge.

Back again. This time with DJ. Good session but loud and noisy due to having 6 dogs in class. Some barking, some owners saying loud commands to their dogs. My dog was distracted more than usual maybe even a little afraid but he did ok.
BTW, don’t use pronged chain collars in Zoom Room. It’s not allowed.
DJ is fantastic! She brings the perfect energy to deal with excited puppies and sometimes overwhelmed owners. We love our classes with her and both learn so much, doggie and parent!

We came back after a year of not training. DJ made it so fun and easy to jump back in. DJ is the best of the best and will always recommend her to anyone looking for an upbeat, encouraging instructor.
Deshawn is a great trainer and our puppy loves his classes!
Deshawn rocks!

Review for Zoom Room – Culver City

This location appears to be professionally run from a customer standpoint, but I believe it’s important to share context for anyone researching the Zoom Room brand more broadly—especially prospective franchise owners.

Zoom Room Culver City is a corporate-owned location, and experiences here may not reflect the realities faced by independently owned franchises. There have been multiple Zoom Room store closures nationwide, and many former franchise owners have publicly discussed significant financial challenges after closing their locations.

Anyone considering investing in a Zoom Room franchise should conduct thorough independent research, including reviewing both current and prior versions of the Franchise Disclosure Document (FDD), speaking directly with current and former franchisees (beyond provided references), and researching independent owner discussions and publicly available regulatory guidance.

Prospective owners should not rely solely on marketing materials or sales presentations and should take time to fully understand the financial risks involved before making long-term commitments.

Lots of great feedback on commands and leash training.
All the trainers so friendly and helpful.
Dj is great!  She is incredibly knowledgeable about dog behavior and psychology.  I’m learning so much from her.  Our puppy is responding very well to her training approach.  Thanks, Dj!!
We have been loving our training with Zoom Room Culver City! All of the instructors have been so amazing and patient while we navigate puppy life!

We have had our rescue puppy for one month now and are in need of training. It's been well over 16 years since I used the Zoom Room to train my previous dog and I had forgotten what it takes to train an indefatigable puppy! I've taken most of my classes so far with an incredible trainer named Omar. He has been very helpful in training me to train my pup. I am appreciative and grateful for all of his guidance in helping us to get our pup trained.
Dj's knowledge and love of dogs is clearly evident and we love her attention to detail.

Zoom Room has a great Puppy Preschool course for our husky puppy.  It's first thing in the morning, so even though she is not fully vaccinated she can still socialize with other pups and get training early on.  The trainers are helpful and provide hands-on assistance when she has trouble focusing.

I did a private training and some group classes..the staff shouldbe more responsive via email/phone. It took multiple emails to get a response. That said seems to work for some people. Not the place for my dog

Now this is the real-deal! Expert trainers are excellent, they completely understand dog (and human-) behavior, they are each really fantastic communicators, and they don’t have anything to prove (no ulterior motives, no ego-trips or eccentricities you sometimes run into with solo private trainers) — they just want you-&-your-dog to succeed.  BTW, they offer great private sessions, as well! My dog responds so well to everyone on staff at Zoom Room, and we always feel not only taken care of, but “seen.”  Such an amazing resource!  Thanks Mr. Boots & Zoom Room Team!  🙌🫶🏆🥇 You folks win BEST-IN-SHOW!

Great first impression. We signed up for a package and have met a few happy customers at the nearby dog park. Then they cancelled our appointments when I knew we had scheduled them. Hard to reach to schedule. We decided to leave the remaining sessions purchased unused.
They were super helpful and friendly explaining the training classes they offer. Great variety too!
Kiana is very knowledgeable and attentive to each dog's learning needs.

I still think this place is bomb! These really are dog people. Not only was the training effective, but the staff is so warm and patient. Looking forward to coming back.

Original review: Wow! I learned tons in my hour-long puppy training class with Jamiee! She so clearly understands how dogs and humans work together and I felt grateful that the class helped me get into these mindsets. It's one thing to train a dog to do a trick, it's another to understand how they think as well as what kind of relationship we are meant to have. I'm so glad I signed up for these classes as a first-time dog owner!

Amazing Dog School,
I have recommended a friend with a puppy as well. We all enjoying great teachers and school!
A must try place!
DJ was patient and really took the time to help me with Wilma! 😊 DJ was gracious and listened to my concerns. Great trainer…best in my experience. DJ is a gifted trainer and stellar human being.

Our pup, Lexy, loves Zoom Room and I love that she is learning so much!  DJ gave us clear and easy do follow instructions.  Friends are now commenting on how well behaved our Lexy is.  Thanks Zoom Room for helping us have a happy pup.
This Zoom Room location has been amazing. The staff are all very professional and work in so many ways. Highly recommend it
The staff are so friendly and create a very fun environment for our dog. Instructors are very patient and our dog loves coming here. Highly recommend.

My rescue pup and I have been coming to zoom room for over a year. He has slowly made his way through calm down classes, obedience, and advanced obedience, with an occasional agility class. Tudou loves coming and whines to get out of the car the minute we park because he knows he’s about to get a lot of treats and belly rubs and pets from the staff. DJ and Kiana are both great and have been patient with my reactive pup, while also giving me ideas of different things to try. The gym is small, so if you have a larger dog, just something to be aware of as you’re taking different classes. I love how much the staff love my pup and haven’t been intimidated by his size or his barks, but have worked with us to make progress!
Omar's patience and experitse have proven wonderful for us. My puppy looks forward to training now and is far more focused on doing well!

My puppy has made great progress in just a few classes at zoom room so far. Classes are a good size for puppies and the trainers are great. My puppy also had a private lesson with Kiana and she is already walking better and not tugging on her leash!
DJ is a great trainer! My dog is improving so much!
My dog makes such good progress with the obedience classes, and has lots of fun in the agility classes!
My dog has such a great time at the zoom room and the trainers do such a great job of teaching us how to train our dog!
Have taken both of our pups here for training
Omar has been great for our 12 week puppy. Highly recommend them

The puppy socialization and puppy obedience classes are super helpful in teaching basic obedience and getting puppies comfortable around other people and dogs.  DJ is an excellent trainer.  She’s very knowledgeable and patient with the pups and their owners.  She follows up with emails containing videos and other tools for us to continue our training at home.

We love Zoom Room Culver City! I love the variety of classes they offer and how easy it is to sign up/cancel online. Our dog took Agility and Obedience classes there and it was a great way to mentally exercise her. Trainers Ashley and Kiana were some of our go-to trainers for the classes we were in - they're so great. Wish we lived closer to their facility.

Kiana is amazing! Very knowledgeable, patient and so enthusiastic and encouraging! She really knows her stuff, you won’t be disappointed if you bring your dog to be trained at the Zoom Room and especially if you’re lucky enough to get Kiana!

I’m not sure how does this store managed to run their business. NOBODY is in the store on Friday when you showed up on your booked appointments, I CANNOT reach to anyone in this store or NO phone number to contact when you showed up on my appointment, especially this is NOT the first time this location mismanaged their schedule and customer’s appointment. This is very frustrating and I’ll NEVER book anything from this location ever again.

Ghosting alert!!! I was ghosted twice at this location. Door’s locked, phone call goes directly to voicemail.

I scheduled an appointment, arrived on time and only to find out the door is locked and nobody is here. The phone number goes directly to a voicemail that’s not been set up. And this happened TWICE in a roll.
Savannah was so attentive and did such a great job explaining the program and different classes to us! We ended up signing up both of our pups and we can’t wait until they start! ❤️
I feel this is an appointment that could have been done over the phone.  I didn’t even meet a trainer or see any example of their skill set so I’m not sure what I garnered from coming.
DJ is such a great instructor! We learn new techniques and training tips each class. She demonstrates great examples. Our puppy Monty loves her and is always excited to see her.

Our trainer DJ is the absolute best! Our pup Bonnie is always so happy to see her. She communicates well and is knowledgeable on specific issues we have with training,  especially with resource guarding. she has given us hope for a more stress free life for Bonnie and us. Highly recommend!
My dog and I love this place. Trainers are great and we are learning and having a lot of fun while doing it
Kiana is a wonderful instructor and all my pups love her.  I like her a lot because not only is it fun class yet she challenges us and we learn more of how to excel with our pups.
DJ was great. Knowledgeable, upbeat, and positive.
Ashley provided excellent customer service. She was very knowledgeable and professional and sensitive to the issues.
Ashley was amazing! So kind and great coaching! Can’t wait to go back!

Zoom Room is a great place to practice and proof my dog’s training!  Their expert dog trainers have helped us meet my training goals for my pup! My pup also loves to attend agility and pup-lates group classes which helps build her confidence! I highly recommend training your dog or just getting some fun excercise in at zoom room!

Love Dj ‘s Obedience class.  She is amazing and gives us so much help with Willow.  At our 4th class, her heroic and calming demonstration showed us a powerful training tool for an energetic 10 mo. Puppy.  We r learning so much and are very grateful to Dj and Zoom Room❤️

DJ at Zoom Room Culver City has been an amazing trainer and resource for us and our rescue pup who struggles with reactivity and stranger danger. DJ has gone above and beyond in working with us to really take the time to figure out our dog's needs. We even had one training session where our dog was too over threshold and overstimulated, and DJ was so kind and understanding - she let us keep our training credit and try again next time. She has taken time out of her own schedule to do Zoom calls, respond to texts, and send resources and tips whenever we are struggling, and it's really made a difference. We still have a lot of work to do, but we are feel so lucky to have found DJ. She is amazing!!
Puppy playgroup with Kiana at the helm is always fun but well structured and orderly. A great opportunity to socialize our little beast and allow him to work off some of that puppy energy.

This is a great place to get training for your new pup or "new to you" pup. The trainers are knowledgeable and very friendly. My dog's trainer remembered Anya's issues and worked with her in class.  The general obedience was also spaced out with "fun"  activities that also helped me get thru the classes myself. Lol.

I only went to the beginner group classes but there are also advanced classes once your pup graduates. You can also rent out the space to work with your dog or even have a party there.
Just had a zoom room class with my puppy and Ashley. She was great and provided many helpful tips

good trainers

Thank you Ashely for all your support in Mr. Kiwé  we will be coming often until he is trained properly Ty.

Boots is the best!
I feel like Bobo can start some training. This place seems amazing like a real gym for dogs.

Alessia

Thank you Jaimee for giving me a pup I can take anywhere. We will continue training with Jaimee for a very long time.

I wanted to add that DJ has been working with Bozeman on agility. She has taught him to listen, take instruction and learn the names of the equipment. It is a great activity for Bozeman and DJ does a great job letting him learn but also have fun.

Bozeman saw DJ again today for Agility. He has so much fun and smiles the entire session. Love Zoom Room.

Bozeman had another training session today with Jaimee. She is fabulous and he loves her. We are working toward Bozeman’s Canine Good Citizen designation and Jaimee is so patient. Bozeman is very high energy but wants to please. We will continue to work with Jaimee. Thank you Zoom Room. Best wishes for a Happy New Year

Bozeman had a great agility session with DJ today using the new curriculum. Under her professional guidance, Bozeman executed most commands. He was so happy and exhausted at the end of his session. We will be joining DJs obedience classes.

Zoom Room Culver City is the best!

Another fun agility session for Bozeman with DJ. He has the best time and Agility really works with his listening abilities.

Today Bozeman attended another obedience group training class with DJ. These classes are very beneficial and Bozeman enjoys them and is learning good behavior. Thank you to DJ for being such a good trainer.

Tonight Bozeman attended his first advanced obedience in pursuit of his Canine Good Citizen.know designation. Jaimee is such an effective trainer and Bozeman benefited from the session. We love Jaimee and Zoom Room

On Thursdays we have private agility training with DJ. Bozeman loves it and it is so good for him mentally and physically. We love our time with DJ

On Fridays Bozeman attends an advanced Obedience class with Jaimee. Our hope is to work toward his Canine Good Citizenship. Jaimee is amazing with her intuition and patience. Bozeman is a very high energy and extremely smart dog. It is sometimes difficult to get his attention. Jaime’s insight and level of expertise is truly a gift.

Today Bozeman did agility with DJ. He loves taking directions from her. It is good for him mentally and physically.

We have a new puppy and he will start puppy obedience with DJ shortly. She is a great trainer. She Is very clear and concise with the dogs while everyone has fun.

Taggart, our 5 1/2 month old puppy, is having fun and benefiting from puppy obedience with DJ. She is a great instructor and the pups love her. I see our Taggart getting his CGC  through training at Zoom Room.
Great facility and great staff!
Kiana is a experienced capable instructor. I would recommend her to everyone

We love the Zoom Room Culver City! My dog's veterinarian originally recommended taking Agility classes at the Zoom Room to help build my dog's confidence as she can be a bit anxious at times, particularly with loud noises. We have done both Obedience and Agility classes. The trainers are great and the classes are fun! I can always tell a difference in my dog's confidence after she takes a class. Definitely recommend the Zoom Room if you're looking for something fun to do with your dog that will also help to strengthen your bond!
Zoom room has been essential to the mental health and well being of our rescue puppy.   She loves agility class with Cecilia.

DJ has been absolutely amazing!!! She is kind, compassionate and gives very clear directions. Even in a class with 5 or more dogs, you feel like you’re getting personalized attention. I am so grateful that my puppy’s first experience with professional training has been a positive one. Thanks to DJ and everyone at Zoom Room for ensuring every dog’s success!!

Update April 2025:  We brought our new dog, Zoë, to Zoom Room for agility classes. Once again, we had DJ as our trainer (yay!!!) and she was awesome as always! I love the supportive nature of everyone at Zoom Room and am grateful to have a fun outlet for Zoë's boundless energy!
Ashley is a patience and engaging instructor. Our Lucy has grown so much with Ashley’s guidance.

Zoom room has been great so far! We just got a puppy and needed to start training somewhere! All of the instructors seem helpful and knowledgeable :) There are many different classes to choose from and we can’t wait to try more.

Ashley is obviously a very competent trainer. But it was her attention to my little Sophie and to me as her owner/handler that made the experience a great one. Sophie is tiny, but I think she will be a great agility dog!

we are very fortunate to come here every weekend with our puppy! we love training on saturdays with kiana and then staying for the puppy play group! very smart and engaged trainers, looking forward to continuing the classes once our puppy grows out of the puppy training!
We loved working with Kirk at Zoom Room! He helped us work on our puppies training skills and provided distractions so she can practice her skills in distracting settings too. It helped a lot!
Nora was a great first puppy instructor for us. She was knowledgeable and controlled the class well, keeping the puppies and humans focused!

Ashley has got to be the best trainer ever!
Her patience and knowledge about dogs is insane! She was able to help us with even the silliest questions in egards to our dog's behavior. I would highly recommend booking her for private lessons!

Dj, Cecilia, and and Kiana have done an excellent job helping my puppy Fig. He’s high energy and low confidence but their classes on puppy socialization through advanced obedience have helped him build some confidence and be much more redirect-able. Though of course there’s also more to learn and reinforce. Fig loves coming to classes and he’s always excited to see these instructors!

I love bringing my dog to Zoom Room! The staff is so friendly, knowledgeable, helpful with tips and tricks, and always make us feel welcomed and special. Kiana pays close attention to each dog to ensure we’re working on new skills. Thank you!

Nice staff and helpful. Unfortunately, small space, loud if dogs bark, and echos. Group classes were unsatisfying with limited individual time and attention. This setting was not effective for my learning and was more frustration for my young dog and me. She learns quickly with me at home and did not learn at all in class nor did I. And I didn't appreciate the limited tactics for training during class. Unfortunately, method did not match with our family. Refund policy is strict and there is no negotiating change in style of training or other less noisy place. She has learned her obedience (sit, down, heel, come) and other tricks (shake, roll over, dance) with operant learning and positive reinforcement quickly at home, but there was limited training that happened in classes.

DJ is such an awesome instructor! She is patient and kind, and shares little tidbits of helpful knowledge throughout the training sessions. I am so glad that DJ is helping teach us and our puppy!!

Edited to add...beware of their * deals*. I purchased the pack of 25 or 30 and after 5 lessons realized it wasn't the right path for our puppy who had chronic diarrhea that got worse with all the treat rewards. Because it had been more than 30 days the manager refused to refund any of our money. Extremely disappointed in their lack of customer service and basically stole our money.
Ashley was again amazing with Penny and we look forward to our next class.

We’ve had a fantastic experience at Zoom Room Culver City! Our five-year-old dog has been taking agility classes here, and we couldn’t be happier with the training and atmosphere. The instructors are knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely care about each dog’s progress. They create a fun and supportive environment that keeps both dogs and owners engaged.

The facility is clean, well-organized, and equipped with everything needed for agility training. If you’re looking for a great place to train your dog, build their skills, and have fun together, we highly recommend Zoom Room Culver City!

My dog Zen is absolutely obsessed with Zoom Room! From the moment we walk in, his excitement is through the roof—he genuinely loves it here. The staff is incredible—so friendly, positive, and loving, making every visit such a great experience.

One of the things I appreciate most is their focus on enrichment activities. Zen is a high-energy dog, and their agility classes are his absolute favorite. He also enjoys tricks and obedience training, which are all taught in a fun, engaging, and rewarding way. The trainers prepare you for all kinds of real-world triggers in a positive and playful environment, which has made a noticeable difference in Zen’s behavior outside of class.

The structured training combined with fun games and challenges keeps him focused and eager to learn. Since starting at Zoom Room, I’ve seen a huge improvement in his focus and obedience, which translates well into everyday life.

If you’re looking for a fantastic training experience that helps build confidence, engagement, and skills for both you and your dog, I highly recommend Zoom Room. It’s truly a game-changer!

I really wanted to love Zoom Room in Culture City, but unfortunately, my experience was overwhelmingly negative—not because of the trainers or the facility itself, but due to the complete disorganization when it came to customer service.

I fully understand the need for an onboarding process, but requiring it in person felt unnecessary, especially in Los Angeles, where I had to drive 45 minutes just for a five-minute chat that could have easily been done over the phone. Still, I signed up for a class for the following week, paid the $30 fee, and left looking forward to the session.

When I arrived the next week—after another hour-long drive with my puppy, who got carsick—things quickly unraveled. I was told that instead of the $30 class I had signed up for, I would need to pay $600 due to a booking mistake made by the owner during my onboarding. I understand that mistakes happen, but what made the situation truly frustrating was that despite my repeated requests, we weren’t allowed to attend even a single class that day. Instead, we were turned away, forced to drive another hour home with a sick puppy who already struggles with car rides.

To make matters worse, when I requested a refund for the $30 class I never attended, no one seemed to remember me, my name, or the situation. I had to call twice just to explain what had happened before they even acknowledged the mistake and processed the refund.

Ultimately, I feel like I wasted hours trying to work with Zoom Room and walked away with nothing but frustration. The lack of organization and customer care was really disappointing. I hope they take steps to improve their booking process and communication because, from what I saw, the trainers and facility seemed great—it’s just everything leading up to the actual experience that made it impossible to even get started.

I have been bringing my dog here since January and we both have loved it. He has moved from basic obedience to advanced obedience. We have tried the tricks class and loved that. Soon we’re going to try the agility fundamentals class and I’m excited for that and hope it goes as well as our other classes.

We have worked with Cecilia, Ashley, and Kiana and have loved working with each of them.

This place is the best training facility i have found. Better than the box store in Miami and West Hollywood, and better than the private training that was very expensive in NYC. Yes my dog gets relocated a lot.

PROS:
1. Trainers are knowledgeable and personable as well as professional and take the time to know you and your dog's needs.
Edit 3/11/25 just spent a private lesson with Ashley and she is exceptionally knowledgeable and very patient with both me and my hyper dog
2. Facility offers different services and classes to meet your interests and the needs/ level of your dog.

Truly there is no other place like the Zoom Room in Culver City! Savvy has really been enjoying Zoom room since she started and its a great way to keep her tired and mentally stimulated. The teachers have been fabulous and i cant wait to get Savvy into more agility classes!

I stumbled upon the Zoom Room in Culver City by accident, and OH MY GOD — this is the best place ever for dogs and their parents! If you're a dog owner in Los Angeles looking for training or just fun indoor classes for your furry friend, you must check them out. They will transform your dog-parenting experience.
Zoom Room offers a wide range of services, including puppy classes, obedience and agility training, private sessions to address specific issues, and even AKC certification. You can join a playgroup or rent the entire space as a private gym for your dog!
The staff is incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful. They also have a convenient online portal where you can view the schedule and book training sessions with ease. Their prices are fantastic compared to most private dog trainers, and they offer various packages and promotions to fit different needs.
From now on, I’ll be recommending Zoom Room to every dog owner I know—it’s an absolute game-changer!

We have been going to Zoom Room | Culver City for the last month and a half, and we have nothing but positive things to say about this location. They also leave time towards the end of sessions to answer any questions from anyone attending. We highly recommend this location and staff!

I am so glad I found this place! My dog, Bernie, is a shy couch potato. She could stand to lose a few pounds (or ten). Her vet told us that the best diet is exercise, so here we are. We’ve taken a few obedience classes here, during which I learned that Bernie is actually pretty smart! She earned four badges in quick succession, allowing us to sign her up for beginning agility classes. In just her first class, she was able to do table, jump, tire, a-frame, and tunnel. Looking forward to watching her progress! There is free parking outside and a wall of treats that Bernie finds irresistible. Not sure how much weight Bernie will lose since I’m basically plying her with treats to keep her attention throughout the class but she is totally pooped after every class (as am I). We’re both ready for a nap afterwards!
Kiana is great with our puppy!! Would definitely recommend her!

Zoom Room has been a wonderful environment to help socialize and begin training my puppy--I was especially appreciative of the "Puppy Pre-school" which allowed my puppy to socialize with other puppies safely in the 2-4 month age range when he wasn't able to be outside (due to vaccine requirements).  The training sessions are helpful not only in class but also at home, giving me the right tools for positive reinforcement training.  Excited to progress from Puppy Training+ into Obedience!

We still need tons more training but obedience has been great for Elliot. Look forward to many more classes with Zoom Room.

We love zoom room. They are incredibly approachable and attentive. The small class sizes are awesome. If you run into issues with your dog, getting sick or injured outside of class, they are very flexible with freezing your class pack.

Our dog loves coming to class and is exhausted when we leave!

Zoom Room was great to do with our puppy to socialize and we loved the instructor (5 stars for that). Unfortunately, I can only give one star because I believe their subscription/membership billing is predatory for the following reasons: (1) you can't cancel your membership online (I have called multiple times and they have not cancelled my membership yet), and (2) they don't inform you that the next payment is coming, they only inform you after you were charged. I had paused my membership for the summer due to travel and forgot it was renewing in September, but only got the notification after I was charged. I have paid for 15 zoom room sessions without my knowledge that we haven't attended.

Overall, I would recommend going to zoom room with a new puppy, but don't sign up for a membership if you don't want the headache. Also, they really should change their standard to allow online cancellation.

I had a nice phone consultation in which we mentioned our pup didn't have a Bordetella shot, and they said it wasn't an issue but would make a note of it. This required multiple follow-ups with the local office via email over a week or so, and I eventually had to call. They quickly gave me a refund, but said they couldn't refund a $35  'administration fee', but I would have to contact the corporate office to 'see about getting that'. There's no number, they just have a general email to send to, and they never responded to several follow-up emails over the span of 2 weeks.
